overrides.note: Quelana appears for a Pyromancy Flame +10 or an Ascended one, with no Laurentius requirement: the flame is upgraded by Laurentius or Eingyi. In both talks the upgrade state calls CollectJustPyromancyFlame, CombineMenuFlagAndEventFlag(365, 331) and OpenEquipmentChangeOfPurposeShop, a reinforcement menu that lists only the flame. Eingyi needs no egg head for it: his menu (t140616 State_3, the flame entry with required_flag -1, leading to State_96) is reached in his state 1281 through States 58, 61, 62 and 23; the egg head (state 1286, SpEffect 5213 or 5214 through flag 753) only widens his shop from rows 3200-3209 to 3200-3299. She leaves for good if the Bed of Chaos dies before she was spoken to.
overrides.source: m14_00_00_00 Event_11400536 (state 1291 and EnableCharacter(6170) once PlayerHasWeapon 1331000-1331500, Pyromancy Flame +10 to +15, or 1332000-1332500, Ascended +0 to +5); Event_11400539 (flag 1296 and DisableCharacter(6170) when flag 10, Bed of Chaos, is on in state 1290, or in 1291 with talk flag 71400061 off); talks t102613 State_82 and t140616 State_96 (CollectJustPyromancyFlame, CombineMenuFlagAndEventFlag 365, 331); m14_00_00_00 Event_11400531 (Eingyi state 1281 after talk flag 11400593) and Event_11400532 (state 1286 with flag 753)
